SELECT "id", "customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:subscriptions}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ($1::text = '')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'seats' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "seats" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'seats' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "seats" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'started_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "started_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'started_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "started_at" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'renews_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "renews_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'renews_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "renews_at" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:subscriptions}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ($1::text = '')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:subscriptions}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:subscriptions}} ("customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::int, $2::text, $3::text, $4::numeric, $5::text, $6::int, $7::timestamptz, $8::date, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:subscriptions}}
SET "customer_id" = $2::int, "plan" = $3::text, "status" = $4::text, "amount" = $5::numeric, "billing_cycle" = $6::text, "seats" = $7::int, "started_at" = $8::timestamptz, "renews_at" = $9::date, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "customer_id", "plan", "status", "amount", "billing_cycle", "seats", "started_at", "renews_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:subscriptions}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:subscriptions}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "id"::text AS label FROM {{table:subscriptions}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "id" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:subscriptions}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
